events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, opened its gates in Bethel, New York in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock's Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, the legendary Woodstock Festival kicked off. Three days of peace, love, and incredible music that defined a generation. What was the most iconic performance for you?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world remembers the passing of the 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, who died on this day in 1977 at the age of 42.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Today marks the 49th anniversary of the passing of Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll. His impact on music and culture is immeasurable, and his songs still resonate today. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur Remembered
events.blurb: The hip-hop world marks the tragic passing of influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who was shot on September 7, 1996, and died six days later on September 13, 1996, at the age of 25.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, the music world lost an icon. Tupac Shakur's powerful lyrics and undeniable talent continue to influence generations. His impact is still felt today.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Music fans worldwide pay tribute to the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since we lost the extraordinary Jimi Hendrix. His revolutionary guitar playing changed music forever and continues to inspire. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on September 26, 1969, and in the US on October 1, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic Album
angles.copy: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album was released today in 1969. That legendary album cover and timeless tracks. What's your go-to song from the record?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The influential lead singer of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders' frontwoman, still rocking and inspiring generations.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The iconic frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Our kid, Liam Gallagher, is 54 today! The voice of a generation, still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis or Liam solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' was released in the US on September 9, 1971, and in the UK on October 8, 1971, featuring the timeless title track.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago, John Lennon released his iconic 'Imagine' album. A powerful message of peace and unity that still resonates today. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: The iPod's 25th Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Turns 25
angles.copy: Can you believe it's been 25 years since the first iPod dropped? It changed everything about how we carried and listened to music. Remember your first one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global celebration of the James Bond film franchise, marking the premiere of 'Dr. No' in 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 007 first hit the big screen. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The world remembers the legendary musician, singer, and songwriter John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: John Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the life and enduring spirit of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire millions around the globe.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his genius for comedy is unparalleled.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unleashed their ambitious 'White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What's your hidden gem from the double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The music world pays tribute to the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since the world lost the irreplaceable Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy – truly one of a kind. Forever a champion.
